verdict.rationale: Unleash's source is publicly hosted on GitHub (unleash-gh-1..4), which lets an AI-native user read the code, but the evidence pack never quotes or names the actual license (e.g. Apache-2.0) or clarifies which parts are open-core vs proprietary (enterprise features like SSO/RBAC referenced in unleash-docs-30/32 suggest a mixed model). missing for 10: explicit license identification, confirmation the entire product (vs only core) is open-licensed.
